newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM precious metals end down, but off early lows.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM precious metals end down, but off early lows.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo precious metal futures ended lower on Thursday, but off early lows as private investors hunted for bargains encouraged by the dollar's rebound against the yen, traders said.
Gold prices ranged from 16 yen to 33 yen per gram lower. Benchmark February was off 18 yen at 1,371 yen.
Gold futures opened lower following sharp losses in New York overnight, but a rebound in bullion prices during Asian hours helped gold futures rebound from the day's lows.
Spot gold was $353.10/40 per ounce at the Tokyo close, against $352.70/353.20 in New York on Wednesday.
